subject: Post-cutover operational handoff: network and runbook verification
messages:
From: Sean Dunn <sean.dunn@acmecloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: 2027-03-07T15:12:00Z
Subject: Final network delta and go window confirmation

Grace,

Quick note from the AcmeCloud ops side — the network deltas we discussed (edge ACLs, static routes to the on-prem transit, and the dedicated VPN peer) are staged for the Wednesday 03/10 maintenance window. Attached is the updated ACL export and the drawing we used during the dry run (network-diagram-v3.pdf).

Before we flip production, can you confirm Redwood's final validation checklist and the exact time you want us to signal the cutover? Also: any last-minute expected traffic patterns we should watch for?

Attachments: network-diagram-v3.pdf (diagram), fw-rule-export-20270307.csv (ACL export)

—Sean
Sean Dunn
Lead SRE, AcmeCloud Inc.
sean.dunn@acmecloud.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sean Dunn <sean.dunn@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Final network delta and go window confirmation

Thanks Sean — received the diagram and ACL export. Below is Redwood's post-cutover handoff plan (high level) and the validation anchors we'll run immediately after the edge changes: 

- Cutover signal: Redwood to initiate at 03/10 02:00 UTC (we'll give a 5-min pre-notify).
- Immediate smoke checks (0–10 min): ping health endpoints, test model inference on a small canary route, verify KV cache warm start and prefix cache hits.
- Network checks (0–20 min): verify static route propagation from transit, validate edge ACL counters, check TCP path MTU on long-payload tests.
- Observability: ensure tracing spans appear in the console for the canary request path and that per-route token latency is within SLO.
- Rollback signal: if any of the above fail, roll back the edge change and revert to the prior peer config (we'll coordinate with AcmeCloud).

I've attached our final runbook (runbook-final.md) which contains exact curl commands and PromQL queries. Priyom — can you add any additional firewall verification steps you want Acme to run from their side? Vivek — any capacity or KV-specific validation to call out?

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Sean Dunn <sean.dunn@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T17:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Final network delta and go window confirmation

Couple of technical checks from the infra checklist I want included in the handoff:

- ACL validation: run a three-hop traceroute from an on-prem test VM to the inference edge and capture both flow and packet-drop counters immediately after the ACL flip. Recommended command: sudo traceroute -T -p 443 -n <edge-ip>.
- BFD/keepalive verification: confirm BGP session timers for the peer don't exceed expected hold time during transition. If you see flaps, hold the change for investigation.
- MTU test: POST a 32KB payload to /v1/health/infer and assert no fragmentation occurs (we log the TCP MSS in the request trace).
- Time sync: verify NTP offsets on the edge routers are < 200ms; if >200ms, Hang on the cutover.

Attachments: sample-validate-commands.txt (included as part of runbook-final.md)

I'll be on the bridge (zoom link in runbook) and will run the Prometheus queries after the flip.

–Priyom
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T19:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Final network delta and go window confirmation

Adding a couple of operational items focused on capacity and graceful degradation:

- Canary sizing: we'll send 10 simultaneous canary inference requests every 10s for the first 5 minutes to exercise batching and KV cache behavior. If tail latency > 2x baseline, trigger rollback.
- Fallback routes: ensure Acme's edge has a pre-configured fallback route that directs to the warm standby transit for the 15-minute window post-cutover.
- Logs & audit: enable extended request headers for the canary path to capture token-level cost attribution for the first 30 minutes.

If all green, we'll open the A/B window (gradual 10% -> 50% -> 100% traffic shift) over the next 90 minutes. If anything degrades, we'll drop back to 0% and cut.

Vivek 
Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Dunn <sean.dunn@acmecloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T02:41:00Z
Subject: Re: Final network delta and go window confirmation

Change record: CR-2027-03-10-ACME-REDWOOD

We'll join the zoom bridge at T-10 and will push logs to the shared folder if we see anything unexpected.

—Sean
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sean Dunn <sean.dunn@acmecloud.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Final network delta and go window confirmation

Thanks all — this reads clean. I signed the DocuSign receipt and attached the final runbook to the change record. Bridge details and the short checklist are at the top of the runbook.

Quick reminders for the execution team:
- Signal cadence: T-10 (pre-notify), T-0 (flip), T+5 (initial smoke), T+30 (A/B decision).
- Escalation path: Priyom (on-call SRE) -> Vivek (infra lead) -> me for exec decisions.
- Post-mortem: 48h readout scheduled; we will capture any regression against token-latency SLOs.

I'll circulate a short post-deploy survey to the CS and ops contacts at T+60.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook-final.md
